Haze blankets Singapore and Malaysia, air quality deteriorates

Air quality in Singapore and parts of Malaysia has deteriorated significantly due to haze, reaching levels not seen since 2019. In Singapore, all regions reported unhealthy air quality. Malaysia recorded unhealthy air quality in 38 areas. The specific cause of the haze was not detailed in the coverage.
